title: I Left the Sticky on the Break-Room Keurig That Only Brewed for Them

parts.text: I put a breakfast blend in the Keurig at 8:07 a.m. and it coughed a tablespoon of brown water. Dana from sales ran a caramel pod two minutes later and got a full cup. I was twenty-seven, standing in socks I should not have worn to the office. I opened the drip tray. My pod was still full; the machine had skipped it. I left a sticky: DESCALE IS NOT A PERSONALITY, RUN THE CYCLE. Dana laughed, then the next caramel also coughed because I had actually started the descale she had been postponing since June. She waited. I waited. The cycle finished at 8:21. Both pods then poured like they had been invented to. Facilities made the sticky a laminated card. Socks survived. Caramel learned humility. Breakfast blend tasted like a full eight ounces, which is all I wanted from a Tuesday.

social.video_title: The Keurig had a favorite pod personality — Part 1/1
social.description: Tablespoon of coffee, caramel full cup, a descale from June. The sticky got laminated. Has a machine ever skipped only you?
